description: The result of a read through a DNS credential

supported.description: False when the provider of the credential has no read call to test with; nothing was asked of any outside service then

state.description: `works`: the zone list and the record read answered. `wrong-key`: the provider refused the key. `missing-right`: the key works but lacks a right (see `needs`). `refused`: the provider does not tell a wrong key from a missing right. `failed`: another provider answer. `unreachable`: no answer in time or no connection. `blocked`: the address was refused by the outbound guard. Null when `supported` is false

zones_seen.description: How many zones the first page of the provider's list held

needs.description: The right the provider's documentation names for this call, only with a refused answer

message.description: The provider's own message with every secret replaced, only with a state other than `works`
